records.question: Assignment as a coordination signal

documented_norm.paraphrase: Assigning helps avoid duplicated work; unassign if unable to continue. Assigned issues may no longer receive work; ask the assignee before taking over, allowing at least a week of inactivity.

records.interpretation_and_limit: Self-assignment and willingness to inspect do not establish continuous effort, a promise to fix or automatic seven-day expiry.

records.question: Scope of maintainer obligation

documented_norm.paraphrase: The guide describes largely voluntary work and says the task list is not a set of expectations.

records.interpretation_and_limit: No deadline stated in the two visible comments; no employment arrangement or comprehensive obligation inferred.

records.question: Triage status versus verification evidence

documented_norm.paraphrase: Applicable triage steps should precede label removal; confirming reproduction on main should receive a comment.

records.interpretation_and_limit: The label was removed, but neither issue comment records reproduction. Check performance is unknown; absence of that detail does not prove omission or violation.

records.question: Review participation and integration rights

documented_norm.paraphrase: Anyone can review; merging ready PRs is reserved to core-team members in the guide.

records.interpretation_and_limit: Approval and actual merge are distinct. Observed merge supports capacity for that action, without a full historical permissions roster.

records.question: Artifact presence and recommended checks

documented_norm.paraphrase: Review guidance includes relevant regression-test references and release notes for user-facing changes.

records.interpretation_and_limit: The artifacts are present; passing all checks, running CI, a distributed release and user benefit remain unverified.

records.question: Documented and observed return routes

documented_norm.paraphrase: Guidance provides for relinquishing assignment and asking about a takeover.

records.interpretation_and_limit: No unassignment in the ten returned timeline entries. A possible route is not an observed route; no-filing and declined routes remain unknown.
